evals.prompt: Look up a user in our Sendbird application without calling anything yet.
evals.expected_output: Confirms the local SENDBIRD_APP_ID / SENDBIRD_API_TOKEN boundary, resolves the current users/viewAUser endpoint and path inputs through Pontx discovery, and prepares a narrow preview-first local read without inventing fields or persisting data in Hub.

evals.prompt: Send a message to one of our group channels.
evals.expected_output: Resolves messages/sendAMessage and its channel_type/channel_url/body inputs, shows a complete request preview (path, body, message_type), requires explicit confirmation before executing the mutation, and keeps the caller's application credentials local.

evals.prompt: Delete a group channel to clean up a test app.
evals.expected_output: Warns that deletion is permanent, resolves deleteAGroupChannel with the channel_url, previews the exact request, and refuses to execute until the caller explicitly confirms the destructive mutation.
